source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 4 Grammar in Use:-ing/-ed 形式作状语(表时间/原因/结果/伴随)。主动且逻辑主语主动发出动作用 -ing;逻辑主语承受动作(被动/状态)用 -ed;分词逻辑主语须与主句主语一致。句子地道、答案唯一。

points.point: -ing 作状语(主动:表时间/原因/结果/伴随)
points.overview: 当分词的逻辑主语(=主句主语)主动发出该动作时,用 -ing 形式作状语,表示时间、原因、结果或伴随。如 Running fast, he won;Having trained hard, she won the title。
当分词的逻辑主语(=主句主语)承受该动作、或处于被动状态时,用 -ed 形式作状语。如 Encouraged by the fans, he played on;Seen from the stand, the players looked tiny。

points.point: 分词逻辑主语一致 + -ing 还是 -ed 的主被动辨析
points.overview: 分词的逻辑主语必须就是主句主语;再看主语与该动作是主动还是被动:主语主动做→ -ing,主语被动受→ -ed。与连词/独立结构辨析一并考查。

questions.stem: ____ fast down the wing, he passed the ball into the net.
questions.explanation: he 主动 run,-ing 作伴随/时间状语 → Running。

questions.stem: ____ hard all winter, the team was ready for the new season.
questions.explanation: the team 主动完成训练且先于主句 → 完成式主动 Having trained。

questions.stem: She ran towards the ball, ____ to score the winning goal.
questions.explanation: she 主动 hope,-ing 作伴随状语 → hoping。

questions.stem: ____ deep breaths, the player tried to calm herself down.
questions.explanation: the player 主动 take breaths → Taking。

questions.stem: ____ that he was the last to shoot, Joe stepped up bravely.
questions.explanation: Joe 主动 know,表原因 → Knowing。

questions.stem: The crowd jumped up, ____ with joy as the ball hit the net.
questions.explanation: the crowd 主动 scream,伴随状语 → screaming。

questions.stem: ____ harder than anyone else, she finally won the title.
questions.explanation: she 主动 train,表原因 → Training。

questions.stem: He left the field early, ____ that he had missed the penalty.
questions.explanation: he 主动 regret,伴随状语 → regretting。

questions.stem: ____ up at the goal, the striker decided where to shoot.
questions.explanation: the striker 主动 look up → Looking。

questions.stem: ____ for the home team all night, the fans went home happy.
questions.explanation: the fans 主动 cheer,表时间/原因 → Cheering。

questions.stem: The goalkeeper dived to the left, ____ the ball with one hand.
questions.explanation: the goalkeeper 主动 stop the ball,结果状语 → stopping。

questions.stem: ____ the ball forward, Jules ran on to it and scored.
questions.explanation: Jules(主语)主动 hit,表时间/伴随 → Hitting。

questions.stem: ____ all his energy, the boxer could hardly raise his arms.
questions.explanation: the boxer 主动 use up energy,表原因 → Using up。

questions.stem: The team trained every day, ____ to reach the final.
questions.explanation: the team 主动 hope,伴随状语 → hoping。

questions.stem: ____ the whistle, the referee ended the first half.
questions.explanation: the referee 主动 blow the whistle,表时间 → Blowing。

questions.stem: ____ the goal, she turned and ran to hug her teammates.
questions.explanation: she 主动完成 score 且先于主句 → Having scored。

questions.stem: He jumped on Jules, ____ loudly with the rest of the team.
questions.explanation: he 主动 celebrate,伴随状语 → celebrating。

questions.stem: ____ that the score was level, both coaches stayed calm.
questions.explanation: both coaches 主动 see,表原因 → Seeing。

questions.stem: The young athlete kept practising, ____ to play for his country.
questions.explanation: the athlete 主动 dream,伴随状语 → dreaming。

questions.stem: ____ the crossbar, the ball bounced away into the crowd.
questions.explanation: the ball 主动 hit the crossbar(球撞到横梁是主动动作)→ Hitting。

questions.stem: ____ by the cheering fans, the players kept fighting to the end.
questions.explanation: players 被 fans 鼓舞,被动 → Encouraged。

questions.stem: ____ from the top of the stand, the players looked very small.
questions.explanation: the players 被看,被动 → Seen。

questions.stem: ____ in the final minute, the home team lost the match.
questions.explanation: the team 被打败,被动 → Beaten。

questions.stem: The boxer played on, ____ by the noise of the crowd.
questions.explanation: the boxer 被人群的喧闹激起(感受被动)→ excited。

questions.stem: ____ to take the last penalty, Jess walked slowly to the spot.
questions.explanation: Jess 被选中,被动 → Chosen。

questions.stem: ____ by years of hard training, she finally won the title.
questions.explanation: she 被多年训练所造就/准备,被动 → Prepared。

questions.stem: The injured player left the pitch, ____ by two teammates.
questions.explanation: the player 被队友扶,被动 → helped。

questions.stem: ____ in bright team colours, the fans filled the whole stand.
questions.explanation: the fans 处于'穿着'状态,被动/状态 → Dressed。

questions.stem: ____ off the team, the boy made up his mind to train harder.
questions.explanation: the boy 被排除在队伍之外,被动 → Left。

questions.stem: The goal was given, ____ by the referee after a quick check.
questions.explanation: the goal 被判有效,被动 → allowed。

questions.stem: ____ by his coach's words, he stepped up with new confidence.
questions.explanation: he 被教练的话所激励,被动 → Inspired。

questions.stem: ____ for the wushu team, Leo flew to Europe for the games.
questions.explanation: Leo 被选入队,被动 → Selected。

questions.stem: The ball, ____ hard by the striker, flew straight into the net.
questions.explanation: the ball 被前锋大力踢,被动 → hit。

questions.stem: ____ by the loud roar, the young player nearly lost his focus.
questions.explanation: the player 被吼声震惊,被动 → Shocked。

questions.stem: ____ in the museum, the old medals tell the story of past wins.
questions.explanation: the medals 被保存,被动 → Kept。

questions.stem: The team played their best, ____ by thousands of home fans.
questions.explanation: the team 被主场球迷支持,被动 → supported。

questions.stem: ____ to play in the rain, the children still enjoyed the game.
questions.explanation: the children 被迫在雨中踢球,被动 → Forced。

questions.stem: ____ as the best player of the match, she thanked her teammates.
questions.explanation: she 被评为最佳球员,被动 → Named。

questions.stem: The trophy, ____ in gold, shone brightly under the stadium lights.
questions.explanation: the trophy 被镀金覆盖,被动/状态 → covered。

questions.stem: ____ by the referee's whistle, the players stopped at once.
questions.explanation: the players 被哨声叫停,被动 → Stopped。

questions.stem: ____ towards the goal, the striker took a powerful shot.
questions.explanation: 逻辑主语 the striker 主动 run → -ing,Running。

questions.stem: ____ by the fans, the tired players found new energy.
questions.explanation: the players 被球迷欢呼鼓舞,被动 → Cheered。

questions.stem: ____ the ball forward, Jess headed for the penalty area.
questions.explanation: Jess 主动 hit the ball → Hitting。

questions.stem: ____ from the high stand, the green pitch looked perfect.
questions.explanation: the pitch 被(从看台)看,被动 → Seen。

questions.stem: ____ the whistle, the referee called full-time.
questions.explanation: the referee 主动 blow → Blowing。

questions.stem: ____ by a teammate, the injured player limped off the field.
questions.explanation: the player 被队友扶,被动 → Helped。

questions.stem: ____ deeply, she tried to calm herself before the shot.
questions.explanation: she 主动 breathe → Breathing。

questions.stem: ____ as the best athlete, Leo felt both proud and shy.
questions.explanation: Leo 被选为最佳,被动 → Chosen。

questions.stem: ____ that the score was level, Joe gave the team a pep talk.
questions.explanation: Joe 主动 know → Knowing。

questions.stem: ____ off the varsity team, the boy worked harder than ever.
questions.explanation: the boy 被排除在队外,被动 → Left。

questions.stem: The fans went wild, ____ loudly when the goal went in.
questions.explanation: the fans 主动 scream,伴随 → screaming。

questions.stem: ____ by his coach, the young player never gave up his dream.
questions.explanation: the player 被教练鼓励,被动 → Encouraged。

questions.stem: ____ the ball into the corner, she rolled it past the keeper.
questions.explanation: she 主动 guide the ball → Guiding。

questions.stem: ____ in team colours, the spectators sang all through the match.
questions.explanation: spectators 处于'穿着'状态,被动/状态 → Dressed。

questions.stem: ____ hard all season, the team felt ready for the final.
questions.explanation: the team 主动完成训练 → 主动完成式 Having trained。

questions.stem: ____ by the loud roar, the new player almost missed his kick.
questions.explanation: the player 被吼声惊到,被动 → Surprised。

questions.stem: He placed the ball on the spot, ____ up at the goal.
questions.explanation: he 主动 look up,伴随 → looking。

questions.stem: ____ to take the final penalty, Jess walked over with heavy steps.
questions.explanation: Jess 被要求/被叫上去,被动 → Asked。

questions.stem: ____ the ball away, the goalkeeper saved the team once more.
questions.explanation: the goalkeeper 主动 punch the ball → Punching。

questions.stem: ____ in gold letters, the team's name shone on the trophy.
questions.explanation: the name 被写,被动 → Written。
